items.fact: Türkiye became the 71st country to sign the Artemis Accords at NASA Headquarters, Washington D.C., on 31 August 2026.

x.w: Türkiye joined the US-led Artemis Accords, which set non-binding principles for peaceful civil exploration of the Moon and space. Its minister signed at a ceremony hosted by NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman, ahead of Türkiye's first lunar mission.
k: Mehmet Fatih Kacır, Minister of Industry and Technology
x.s: The Artemis Accords were launched in October 2020 by the US with eight founding signatories; India signed in June 2023 as the 27th country.

items.fact: The SCO designated Lahore (Pakistan) as its Tourism and Cultural Capital for 2026–27; the decision was finalised at the 26th SCO Heads of State meeting in Bishkek.

x.w: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation rotates a Tourism and Cultural Capital title each year among member states to promote tourism and people-to-people contacts. Lahore was named at the Bishkek summit, which closed Kyrgyzstan's 2025-26 chairmanship.
x.s: The SCO was founded in 2001 in Shanghai, has its secretariat in Beijing, and India became a full member in 2017.

items.fact: Lionel Messi retired from international football on 31 August 2026 with 125 goals in 207 appearances for Argentina.

x.w: Messi ended 21 years with Argentina, whose highlights include the 2022 World Cup win. He is Argentina's all-time top scorer and played six World Cups.
x.s: Argentina won the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar, beating France on penalties, and Messi has won a record eight Ballon d'Or awards.

items.fact: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi (15, East Zone) became the youngest player to score a Duleep Trophy half-century, breaking a 57-year-old record.

x.w: The 15-year-old opener reached his fifty in 42 balls in the semi-final and fell for 92, eight short of a century that would have broken Sachin Tendulkar's record as the youngest Duleep Trophy centurion.
k: 92 off the innings against Central Zone (semi-final)
x.s: The Duleep Trophy is India's oldest first-class zonal tournament, named after Kumar Shri Duleepsinhji, and began in 1961-62.

items.fact: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan released Mission Rangeen Machhli 2031, a strategic action plan for ornamental fisheries, at Agatti, Lakshadweep (31 Aug 2026).

x.w: The strategic action plan sets uniform national standards for the ornamental fish sector, covering breeding, biosecurity, quality control and trade, and aims to grow a fisheries-led Blue Economy. Lakshadweep was chosen for its coral reefs rich in marine ornamental species.
k: Broodstock, breeding, hatcheries, quarantine, traceability, trade
x.s: Lakshadweep is a Union Territory with its capital at Kavaratti, and the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) was launched in 2020.

items.fact: India's first-of-its-kind Green Forge Complex for testing GM crops was inaugurated at BRIC-NABI, Mohali, Punjab, on 31 August 2026.

x.w: The Green Forge complex has controlled chambers that vary light, humidity and temperature to mimic different climates, so newly developed GM crop varieties can be tested before recommendation for cultivation in specific regions. It was opened during the National Conclave on BioE3 2026.
k: Dr Jitendra Singh, Union MoS (Science and Technology)
Climate simulation chambers for GM crop trials
x.s: BRIC-NABI (National Agri-Food and Biomanufacturing Institute) at Mohali is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council under the Department of Biotechnology; BioE3 stands for Biotechnology for Economy, Environment and Employment.

items.fact: Japan Credit Rating Agency (JCR) upgraded India's long-term sovereign issuer rating to A- from BBB+ with a Stable outlook (2 Sep 2026).

x.w: JCR raised India's rating by one notch citing solid growth, supportive policies, strong consumption and investment, and a sounder financial system. It is an unsolicited rating, issued without a request from the government.
k: Also upgraded to A- from BBB+
Over 6 per cent in the current fiscal
x.s: JCR (Japan Credit Rating Agency) is a Tokyo-based credit rating agency.

items.fact: Gollalagudi Temple in Palampet, Mulugu district, Telangana, was declared a monument of national importance, raising ASI-protected monuments in Telangana to 10.

x.w: The ASI notified the Kakatiya-era temple through a gazette notification dated 31 August. It stands next to the Ramappa (Rudreshwara) temple and is noted for its carvings.
x.s: The Ramappa (Kakatiya Rudreshwara) Temple at Palampet was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021.

items.fact: Air Marshal KAA Sanjeeb took over as Air Officer-in-Charge Maintenance (AOM) of the Indian Air Force on 1 September 2026.

x.w: Air Marshal Sanjeeb, an expert on AWACS and mid-air refuelling aircraft, took over the IAF's maintenance wing after his predecessor retired on 31 August.
x.s: The Indian Air Force was established on 8 October 1932 and is headed by the Chief of the Air Staff.

items.fact: Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma became the first non-medical woman officer of the Indian Armed Forces to attain two-star rank (Sep 2026).

x.w: AVM Shakti Sharma, commissioned into the IAF Education Branch in 1994, assumed charge as Assistant Chief of the Air Staff (Education) at Air Headquarters, making her the first non-medical woman officer to reach two-star rank in the armed forces.
k: Assistant Chief of the Air Staff (Education)
First woman tri-service officer to command a Sainik School (Kapurthala)
x.s: Sainik Schools are run under the Ministry of Defence, and the first one was set up at Satara in 1961.

items.fact: The RBI appointed Suman Ray as Executive Director on 1 September 2026; he earlier served as Regional Director for Maharashtra.

x.w: Suman Ray was promoted from Regional Director for Maharashtra. He has over three decades in the RBI across currency management, financial inclusion, payment systems and consumer protection.
k: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) and Premises Department
x.s: The RBI was established on 1 April 1935, has its headquarters in Mumbai, and was nationalised in 1949.

items.fact: India hosted the World Archery Para Series 2026 (Stage 3) for the first time at Sabarmati Riverfront, Ahmedabad, from 5 to 9 September 2026.

x.w: It was Stage 3 of the series, held over 5 to 9 September with 20 countries and four divisions (Recurve, Compound, W1 and VI). Stage 4 follows in Santiago, Chile, in October 2026.
x.s: World Archery, the international federation, is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland, and was founded in 1931.

items.fact: Sheetal Devi won her first individual World Archery Para Series title in women's compound at Ahmedabad; India finished with 15 medals.

x.w: The 19-year-old world champion beat Kazakhstan's Aizada Seidan in a shoot-off after the final ended 144-144. She also set a mixed-team compound qualification world record with Rakesh Kumar.
k: 1400 points with Rakesh Kumar in compound mixed team qualification
x.s: Sheetal Devi is from Kishtwar, Jammu and Kashmir, and won mixed team compound bronze at the Paris 2024 Paralympics.

items.fact: The ICC named India host of the inaugural Women's Champions Trophy, a six-team T20I event from 14 to 28 February 2027.

x.w: The ICC moved the inaugural edition to India after Sri Lanka lost the hosting rights over reforms Sri Lanka Cricket had yet to complete. There are no semi-finals; the top two teams after a round robin play the final.
k: Cricket Club of India, Mumbai and Vadodara International Cricket Stadium
Australia, England, India, New Zealand, South Africa, Sri Lanka
x.s: The ICC is headquartered in Dubai.

items.fact: The IAF successfully drop-tested the indigenous long-range glide bomb Khagantak-243 from a Su-30MKI on 2 September 2026.

x.w: The 300 kg long-range glide bomb was developed by Nagpur-based JSR Dynamics with Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) and is claimed to reach about 144 to 180 km when released from around 12 km altitude.
x.s: The Su-30MKI is the IAF's twin-seat multirole fighter, built under licence in India by HAL.

items.fact: Baljeet Kaur and Skalzang Rigzin received Land Adventure awards among the Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Awards 2024, announced on 2 September 2026.

x.w: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports announced four awardees for 2024. Baljeet Kaur is the first Indian to climb five 8000 m peaks in a single season, and Skalzang Rigzin is described as the first Indian to summit Everest without supplemental oxygen or Sherpa support.
k: Rs 15 lakh each, plus statuette and certificate
Land, Water, Air Adventure and Lifetime Achievement
x.s: The award is named after Tenzing Norgay, who made the first ascent of Mount Everest with Edmund Hillary in 1953.

items.fact: The 16th Aero India will be held at Yelahanka Air Force Station, Bengaluru, from 8 to 12 February 2027.

x.w: Aero India is Asia's largest air show, organised by the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence. Exhibitor registration opens on 3 September 2026 at aeroindia.gov.in.
k: Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence
x.s: Aero India has been held at Bengaluru since 1996 and is biennial.

items.fact: Rajnath Singh released RAKSHA, a 10-year defence diplomacy framework with four pillars, in New Delhi on 3 September 2026.

x.w: RAKSHA is a 10-year roadmap for India's defence partnerships, security cooperation and defence manufacturing outreach, aligned with a goal of India acting as a net security provider in the Indian Ocean Region.
k: Strategic Partnerships, Capacity Building, Indigenous Exports, Maritime Security
x.s: The Ministry of Defence is housed in South Block, New Delhi, and is headed by the Raksha Mantri.

items.fact: ISRO's GSLV-F17 (19th GSLV mission) launched the 2,367 kg EOS-05 earth observation satellite from Sriharikota on 4 September 2026.

x.w: GSLV-F17 lifted off at 2:55 AM IST from the Second Launch Pad and placed EOS-05 in a sub-geosynchronous transfer orbit about 19 minutes later. EOS-05 is India's first imaging satellite designed to operate from geosynchronous orbit.
x.s: The Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SHAR) is in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, and ISRO is headquartered in Bengaluru.

items.fact: UNGA declared 27 November as the International Day for the Elimination of Child, Early and Forced Marriage; India co-sponsored the resolution.

x.w: The resolution (A/80/L.99) was adopted by consensus on 4 September 2026. It was brought by Sierra Leone with over 60 co-sponsors, and calls for awareness campaigns and national strategies to end early marriage.
x.s: Ending child marriage is part of SDG target 5.3, and India's Prohibition of Child Marriage Act 2006 sets the minimum marriage age at 18 for women and 21 for men.

items.fact: UNGA adopted the Togo-sponsored 'Correct the Map' resolution on 4 September 2026 with 164 votes; the United States voted against.

x.w: The Africa-led resolution urges map projections that show the true relative size of continents, challenging the Mercator projection that makes Africa look smaller. It is not legally binding.
k: Estonia, Georgia, Lithuania, Moldova, Serbia, Ukraine
x.s: The Mercator projection was devised by Gerardus Mercator in 1569, and the UN General Assembly is headquartered in New York.

items.fact: The Rangpur-Sivasagar Historical Ensemble of the Ahom dynasty in Assam was added to UNESCO's World Heritage Tentative List.

x.w: India's dossier for the ensemble, showcasing 600 years of Ahom heritage and water-based urban planning, was submitted on 19 June 2026 under UNESCO criteria (iii) and (iv).
k: Rang Ghar, Talatal Ghar, Joysagar and Gaurisagar tanks
x.s: The Charaideo Moidams of the Ahom dynasty were inscribed in 2024 as India's 43rd World Heritage Site.

items.fact: Adobe named Anil Chakravarthy its next president and CEO; Shantanu Narayen will become Executive Chair on 1 December 2026.

x.w: Adobe's board unanimously picked its customer-experience chief to lead the company through an AI-driven shift. He joins the board when he takes over on 1 December 2026, while Narayen stays as Executive Chair.
k: President, Customer Experience Orchestration business and worldwide field operations
x.s: Adobe is headquartered in San Jose, California, was founded in 1982, and Shantanu Narayen has been CEO since December 2007.

items.fact: India and Japan will play their first men's T20I, named the Suzuki Cup, on 22 September 2026 at Sano, Tochigi, Japan.

x.w: The one-off match marked the 75th anniversary of Japan-India diplomatic relations and was the first step of the 'Sport 75' initiative agreed between the two prime ministers. India won a rain-shortened five-over match by 2 runs.
k: Suzuki Cup: 75th Anniversary of Japan-India Diplomatic Relations Commemorative Match
India won by 2 runs (5 overs a side)
x.s: Japan's capital is Tokyo, and cricket returns to the Olympics at Los Angeles 2028 in T20 format.

items.fact: Amit Shah launched the Nasha Mukt Bharat 2029 anti-narcotics roadmap in Panaji, Goa, on 6 September 2026.

x.w: The three-year roadmap (2026 to 2029) targets drug-network disruption, recovery of fugitives, destruction of clandestine labs and demand reduction. Shah launched it after a security and narcotics review with Goa CM Pramod Sawant.
k: 100 networks dismantled, 100 fugitives brought back, 100 clandestine labs destroyed
50 crore citizens, 1 lakh Nasha Mukt Mitras
x.s: Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan was launched on 15 August 2020 by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, and the Narcotics Control Bureau (est. 1986) works under the Home Ministry.

items.fact: Dr. Dinesh Sharma, former UP Deputy CM, was appointed Lieutenant Governor of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands on 5 September 2026.

x.w: The President appointed the former UP Deputy Chief Minister (2017 to 2022) and ex-Mayor of Lucknow as LG of the Union Territory, replacing Admiral D K Joshi (retd). He assumed office on 15 September 2026.
k: Deputy CM of Uttar Pradesh, Mayor of Lucknow
x.s: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands is a Union Territory administered under Article 239, with its capital at Sri Vijaya Puram (formerly Port Blair).

items.fact: Justice Sanjay Kumar Agrawal was appointed the 44th regular Chief Justice of the Rajasthan High Court on 5 September 2026.

x.w: The Centre notified eight new High Court Chief Justices in one order, so all 25 High Courts now have regular Chief Justices. Justice Agrawal was transferred from the Chhattisgarh High Court on the Supreme Court Collegium's recommendation of 31 August.
k: Governor Haribhau Bagde, at Raj Bhavan, Jaipur
x.s: High Court Chief Justices are appointed by the President under Article 217, and the Rajasthan High Court has its principal seat at Jodhpur with a bench at Jaipur.

items.fact: Andrea Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes) won the 2026 Italian Grand Prix at Monza, the first Italian to win his home GP in 60 years.

x.w: The 20-year-old Mercedes driver won from 19th on the grid, making 25 overtakes, for his seventh win of the season. The race had a red-flag restart after Charles Leclerc crashed at the Parabolica on lap two.
x.s: The Italian Grand Prix is held at the Autodromo Nazionale Monza near Milan.

items.fact: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty won their maiden China Masters badminton title at Shenzhen on 6 September 2026.

x.w: The top-seeded Indian pair came from a game down to beat China's He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu in the final, and are the first Indian pair to win the China Masters since it began in 2005. They had twice been runners-up in the event.
k: 11-21, 21-13, 21-17 against He Ji Ting / Ren Xiang Yu
x.s: Satwik and Chirag won the men's doubles gold at the 2023 Asian Games in Hangzhou.

items.fact: The 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah (9 Sep–8 Oct 2026) of the Ministry of WCD has the theme 'Hamari Anganwadi, Hamari Jimmedari'.

x.w: Poshan Maah is the Ministry of Women and Child Development's annual month-long nutrition campaign. The 2026 edition was launched at Varanasi and puts Anganwadi centres at the centre of community-led nutrition action, with emphasis on dietary diversity, protein and hot-cooked meals.
k: Dietary diversity with protein, fresh hot-cooked meals under SNP
x.s: Poshan Abhiyaan was launched on 8 March 2018 at Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan, and the Ministry of Women and Child Development is the nodal ministry.

items.fact: Veteran Kannada actor Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 at the 72nd National Film Awards.

x.w: President Droupadi Murmu presented the award for 2024 to Anant Nag, a Kannada actor with more than five decades in cinema and over 300 films across several languages. It was the first National Film Awards ceremony held outside New Delhi.
k: More than 300 films, over five decades
x.s: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award, India's highest cinema honour, was instituted in 1969 and the first recipient was Devika Rani.

items.fact: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi under its 2026 chairship; leaders adopted the New Delhi Declaration on 12 September 2026.

x.w: India chaired BRICS in 2026 and hosted the summit at Bharat Mandapam under the motto of building for resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability. The consensus declaration ran to 140 paragraphs.
k: Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
x.s: The first BRIC summit was held in Yekaterinburg, Russia, in 2009, and India earlier hosted BRICS at Goa in 2016.

items.fact: The Defence Acquisition Council chaired by Rajnath Singh granted AoN for proposals worth about ₹1.10 lakh crore on 7 September 2026.

x.w: About 98 per cent of the proposals are to be sourced from Indian industry. Army items include CBRN reconnaissance vehicles, high mobility vehicles, mechanical mine layers, Advanced Light Helicopters, trawl tanks and the Sarvatra bridge system.
k: CBRN Recce Vehicles, HMV, mine layers, ALH, trawl tanks, Sarvatra bridge
x.s: The Defence Acquisition Council, the MoD's highest procurement body chaired by the Defence Minister, was set up in 2001, and AoN (Acceptance of Necessity) is the first approval step.

items.fact: SPJIMR Mumbai ranked 26th globally and 2nd in India in the Financial Times Masters in Management (FT MiM) 2026 ranking.

x.w: SPJIMR climbed nine places from 35th in 2025 and is India's second-best school in the ranking, behind IIM Bangalore and ahead of IIM Ahmedabad. Fourteen Indian schools featured, up from eleven.
x.s: SPJIMR is Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan's S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research in Mumbai, and the Financial Times is published from London.

items.fact: Goa Police received the President's Colour from Amit Shah on 7 September 2026, the fifth state police force to get it.

x.w: The President's Colour is the highest ceremonial honour for a police force. It was presented at the Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium in Taleigao, and Shah also launched an AI-based multilingual voice assistant for the cyber-crime helpline 1930.
k: Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium, Taleigao
AI multilingual voice assistant for helpline 1930
x.s: Goa was liberated from Portuguese rule in 1961 and became India's 25th state in 1987.

items.fact: Tata Advanced Systems emerged lowest bidder (L1) for the ₹20,000 crore Project Zorawar light tank programme for the Indian Army.

x.w: The Ministry of Defence picked Tata Advanced Systems after a three-year evaluation of five bids, under the Make-1 route. It would be the first time a private company independently builds a battle tank for the armed forces.
k: Mahindra Defence Systems, to also build a prototype
x.s: Zorawar Singh was a Dogra general under Maharaja Gulab Singh of Jammu, and the light tank is meant for high-altitude terrain where T-72 and T-90 tanks are limited.

items.fact: Ocean Research Vessel ORV Sagar Manthan, built by GRSE for NCPOR under the Deep Ocean Mission, was launched in Kolkata on 9 September 2026.

x.w: The multidisciplinary, all-weather vessel is designed to work in harsh seas including the Southern Ocean, with a service life of about 30 years. It will gradually replace the ageing ORV Sagar Kanya.
x.s: NCPOR is headquartered in Goa under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, and the Deep Ocean Mission was approved in 2021 with an outlay of Rs 4,077 crore.

items.fact: The 20th Asian Games (Aichi-Nagoya 2026), Japan, run from 19 September to 4 October 2026 with 469 medal events.

x.w: The 20th Asian Games features 43 sports and 71 disciplines with more than 11,000 athletes from 45 countries and regions. Padel, teqball, surfing, BMX freestyle and MMA debut, while breaking and esports are retained.
k: Padel, teqball, surfing, BMX freestyle, MMA
x.s: The first Asian Games were held in New Delhi in 1951, the games are run by the Olympic Council of Asia, and the previous edition was Hangzhou 2023.

items.fact: India-Japan air exercise Veer Guardian-2026 (second edition) is held at Air Force Station Jodhpur from 9 to 22 September 2026.

x.w: This is the first time Japanese fighters have been deployed at an Indian air base. The IAF fielded Tejas, Su-30MKI and Rafale jets while the JASDF sent three F-2A fighters and over 100 personnel; the first edition was held in Japan in 2023.
x.s: India-Japan bilateral exercises include JIMEX (navy), Dharma Guardian (army) and Veer Guardian (air force).

items.fact: The 22nd edition of India-US army exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026 is held at Auli (Uttarakhand) and Mahajan Field Firing Ranges (Rajasthan).

x.w: The exercise began on 15 September and runs to 28 September with around 600 personnel from each army. Auli hosts high-altitude training, while Mahajan saw live firing with M777, Dhanush and Pinaka systems.
k: M777, Dhanush, Pinaka, L70 guns, M-LIDS
x.s: Yudh Abhyas is an annual India-US army exercise held alternately in the two countries.

items.fact: INS Mysore took part in India-Malaysia bilateral naval exercise Samudra Laksamana 4/26 at Lumut Naval Base, Malaysia.

x.w: INS Mysore reached Lumut on 9 September and the exercise ran until 12 September, with a harbour phase and a sea phase alongside Royal Malaysian Navy ships.
k: KD Lekir and KD Gagah Samudera
x.s: INS Mysore is a Delhi-class guided-missile destroyer, and Lumut in Perak is the main base of the Royal Malaysian Navy.

items.fact: ISRO hot-tested the indigenous CE20 cryogenic engine at an uprated 220 kN thrust at Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu, on 9 September 2026.

x.w: This was a flight acceptance hot test of the engine meant for the C32 cryogenic upper stage of an upcoming LVM3 mission at uprated thrust. The LOX Tank Pressurisation Module for the C32 stage of Gaganyaan missions was also demonstrated.
k: C32 upper stage of upcoming LVM3 mission
Sea-level hot test at 22-tonne thrust in March
x.s: The CE20 was developed by ISRO's Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre and powers the cryogenic upper stage of LVM3.

items.fact: NPCI launched UPI Tap & Pay and the AI-powered My UPI platform at Global Fintech Fest 2026; the PIN-less limit is ₹5,000.

x.w: The NFC-based Tap & Pay lets users pay by tapping an unlocked phone on a POS terminal without needing mobile internet. My UPI gives a single view of UPI transactions and AutoPay mandates and adds user controls such as a Safety Switch.

Safety Switch to decline UPI debits if compromised
x.s: NPCI was set up in 2008 and is headquartered in Mumbai, and UPI was launched in April 2016.

items.fact: Nirbhay Choudhary set a men's hammer throw national record of 71.02 m and Tanya Chaudhary a women's record of 68.35 m (10 Sep 2026).

x.w: Both marks came at the Indian Athletics Final Series. Nirbhay broke a 10-year-old record and became the first Indian to cross 71 m, while Tanya bettered Anushka Yadav's mark.
x.s: The men's hammer weighs 7.26 kg and the women's hammer 4 kg, and Indian athletics is governed by the Athletics Federation of India.

items.fact: Tung Chee-hwa, the first Chief Executive of Hong Kong SAR (1997–2005), died at the age of 89.

x.w: Tung died on 8 September 2026. Born in Shanghai in 1937, he was a shipping-magnate's son who studied at the University of Liverpool and later served as a vice chairman of the CPPCC.
x.s: Hong Kong returned to China on 1 July 1997, and Tung's successor as Chief Executive was Donald Tsang in 2005.

items.fact: The 18th BRICS Summit was held in New Delhi on 12-13 September 2026 and adopted the New Delhi Declaration 2026 backing local-currency trade.

x.w: The summit was chaired by PM Modi at Bharat Mandapam. The New Delhi Declaration covers UN and IMF reform, de-dollarisation, AI governance, backing for comprehensive UNSC reform and condemnation of terrorism.
k: UN/IMF reform, local-currency trade, AI governance, terrorism
Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa, UAE
x.s: BRICS's New Development Bank is headquartered in Shanghai and was established in 2015.

items.fact: Veteran actor Anant Nag was named for the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024, presented at the 72nd National Film Awards in Kevadia, Gujarat (Sep 2026).

x.w: The award for 2024 was handed over by the President at the 72nd National Film Awards, which recognise films of 2024 and were held outside Delhi for the first time. Nag has acted in Kannada, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam and Marathi films.
k: Kannada, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Marathi
x.s: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award carries a Swarna Kamal, a cash prize of Rs 10 lakh and a shawl.

items.fact: The Marathi film Gondhal, directed by Santosh Davakhar, was selected as India's official entry for Best International Feature Film at the 99th Academy Awards.

x.w: The Film Federation of India chose Gondhal from 33 submitted films. It is set in rural Maharashtra over a single night around a ritual for a newlywed couple, and is the fourth Marathi film picked as India's Oscar entry.
k: Silver Peacock for Best Director, IFFI 2025 (56th)
x.s: The Oscar category was renamed Best International Feature Film in 2020, and India's only nominees so far are Mother India, Salaam Bombay! and Lagaan.

items.fact: India ranked 131st of 145 countries in the WEF Global Gender Gap Index 2026, unchanged from 2025, with a parity score of 64.5%.

x.w: India's score edged up but stayed below the global average of 69.2 per cent, with economic participation the weakest area. Political empowerment was India's best-ranked subindex.

items.fact: Delhi ranked first in NITI Aayog's India Electric Mobility Index (IEMI) 2025 with a score of 84, followed by Maharashtra (78) and Karnataka (73).

items.fact: GIFT City rose nine places to 37th in the Global Financial Centres Index 40 (GFCI 40), published by Z/Yen Partners and China Development Institute.

items.fact: The Union Cabinet raised the EPFO wage ceiling for mandatory coverage from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 per month, effective 17 September 2026.

x.s: EPFO is a statutory body under the Ministry of Labour and Employment, functioning under the EPF and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952.

Rs 5 per transaction (railways, telecom, insurance, fuel and others) above Rs 2,000

Up to Rs 1 lakh per month via UPI QR

items.fact: Tavengwa Mukuhlani became the first Zimbabwean to be appointed Deputy Chairperson of the International Cricket Council (Sep 2026).

items.fact: Luke Lindberg of the USA was appointed Executive Director of the World Food Programme (HQ Rome), becoming its youngest head (Sep 2026).

k: USDA Under Secretary for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs
x.s: The World Food Programme was founded in 1961 and won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2020.

items.fact: Nobel laureate Michael Kremer was appointed World Bank Chief Economist from 1 October 2026, succeeding Indermit Gill.

x.w: Kremer, a University of Chicago professor, is the first person to take up the World Bank chief economist post while already a Nobel laureate. He shared the 2019 Economics Nobel for experimental approaches to reducing global poverty.
k: World Bank Group President Ajay Banga (16 September 2026)
2019, shared with Abhijit Banerjee and Esther Duflo
